author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Provides named, configurable, privacy-conscious cross-platform points for chat consistency, observed active/lurk time, and supported community events.
changelog: 4.1.100: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.100, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. Unreleased: added stable-ID search, guided verified link management, privacy-preserving administration history, and fail-closed correction undo. 2.5.1: added creator-named currency, source-routed balance lookup, chat consistency, observation-based active/lurk time, configurable event awards, and bounded multi-platform session settlement. 2.4.2: initial foundation slice with installation-local pseudonyms, explicit stable-ID account links, fixed point awards, chat cooldowns, replay protection, bounded private state, a permission/dependency-gated broker service, and authenticated wizard status, export, correction, and deletion operations.

manifest.name: Viewer Foundation
installationSteps: Open the built-in Viewer Foundation page and review its private identity and progression settings.
Optionally add explicit account links using viewer-id|platform|stable-user-id. Never link accounts by display name.
Name the currency and choose chat, consistency, observed time, lurk, and event awards; then save and restart StreamBridge.
Choose the balance and lurk command names. They work through your existing chat connection after restart.
uninstallationSteps: Viewer Foundation is a required Bridge integration and cannot be uninstalled separately.

healthChecks.description: Checks your points name, private viewer matching, chat/watch-time/event points within their limits, protection against counting an event twice, and safe saving of private progress.
